Question: Products per product line
Expected SQL: SELECT productLine, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY productLine;
Generated SQL:
SELECT pl."productLine", COUNT(p."productCode") AS product_count
FROM "productlines" pl
JOIN "products" p ON p."productLine" = pl."productLine"
GROUP BY pl."productLine"
ORDER BY pl."productLine";

Question: Employees per office

FROM "offices" o
LEFT JOIN "employees" e ON e."officeCode" = o."officeCode"

ORDER BY o."city";

FROM "products" p
JOIN "productlines" pl ON p."productLine" = pl."productLine"
GROUP BY pl."productLine"

Question: Orders per customer
Expected SQL: SELECT c.customerName, COUNT(o.orderNumber) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName ORDER BY order_count DESC;

FROM "customers" c
LEFT JOIN "orders" o ON c."customerNumber" = o."customerNumber"
